items.title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
items.text: This guide provides remediation steps for common operational errors, environment constraints, and editor integrations when using Protostar.

items.title: Missing Dependencies & Environment Checks
items.text: Protostar verifies system-level dependencies during its pre_flight() phase before writing files or modifying configurations. If a required binary is missing, execution halts with a MissingDependencyError.

items.title: uv is not installed or not in $PATH
items.text:
Protostar strongly recommends uv for high-velocity package resolution and environment management.

macOS & LinuxHomebrew (macOS)Windows (PowerShell) 
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

brew install uv

powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"

Verifying $PATH Resolution

If you installed tools via uv tool, ensure your shell's environment includes ~/.local/bin: 

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

items.title: Optional Binaries (direnv, just, prek)
items.text: If an optional tool (such as direnv or just) is not installed on your system when requested, Protostar logs a non-fatal diagnostic warning and safely skips subprocess initialization without aborting repository creation.

items.title: Workspace Collisions
items.text:
When Protostar detects pre-existing configuration markers (such as an existing pyproject.toml or README.md) in the target workspace, it raises a WorkspaceCollisionError to protect your existing work.

Workspace Collision: Protostar detected existing configuration files in the workspace.
  - pyproject.toml

items.title: Interactive Resolution
items.text:
In interactive terminals, you can choose from three strategies:

  1. Merge (Default): Deep-merges AST tables and arrays into pyproject.toml and appends missing rules to .gitignore, preserving all your custom settings and comments.
  2. Overwrite: Overwrites existing configuration keys with Protostar's baseline standards.
  3. Abort: Safely cancels the operation without making changes.

items.title: Automated Environments (CI/CD & Agents)
items.text:
In non-interactive environments or when running with --json, interactive prompts are disabled. Pass explicit strategy flags to proceed:

# Safely deep-merge into existing configs:
protostar init --template cli --force-merge

# Forcefully overwrite existing configs:
protostar init --template cli --force-replace

items.title: Remote Template Security Alerts
items.text:
When you load a template from an untrusted remote URL (--from https://...) that contains executable system_tasks or post_install_tasks, Protostar halts execution to display the Informed Consent Security Dialog:

⚠️  REMOTE TEMPLATE WARNING ⚠️

This template was loaded from an external source and will execute the following shell commands on your system:
  - uv run nbdime config-git --enable

Do you trust this source to modify your system? [y/N]

items.title: Bypassing Prompts for Trusted Templates
items.text:
To permanently trust a remote or team template and bypass security prompts:

  1. Run protostar config to open your global settings.
  2. Register the template under the [templates] table:
[templates]
team-backend = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YourOrg/standards/main/backend.toml"
  1. Invoke it via shorthand: protostar init --template team-backend.

items.title: Editor Schema Setup for Custom Templates
items.text: Protostar templates are pure TOML files validated against a JSON Schema. Configuring your editor provides instant autocompletion, hover tooltips, and real-time schema validation.

items.title: VS Code & Cursor
items.text:
1. Install the Even Better TOML extension (tamasfe.even-better-toml).
  2. Add the schema modeline at the top of your custom protostar.toml file:
#:schema https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jacksonfergusondev/protostar/main/schemas/template.schema.json

name = "my-custom-template"
dependencies = ["fastapi", "uvicorn"]
ruff = true

Alternatively, export the schema locally for offline validation:

protostar export-schema --json > protostar-template.schema.json

items.title: JetBrains (PyCharm / IntelliJ)
items.text:
1. Open Settings / Preferences $\to$ Languages & Frameworks $\to$ Schemas and DTDs $\to$ JSON Schema Mappings.
  2. Add a new mapping named Protostar Template.
  3. Set the schema URL to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jacksonfergusondev/protostar/main/schemas/template.schema.json.
  4. Add the file pattern *protostar*.toml.

items.title: Verbose Debugging (--verbose)
items.text:
To view full Python tracebacks and detailed debug logs, append -v or --verbose to any command:

protostar init --template cli --verbose

items.title: Automated Crash Reporting
items.text:
If Protostar encounters an unexpected internal error or AST collapse:

  1. It traps the exception to prevent incomplete disk operations.
  2. It collects non-sensitive system environment vectors (OS, Python version, command invocation).
  3. It outputs a URL-encoded link that opens a pre-formatted GitHub issue ticket with the exact telemetry attached.
